anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, 15 minutes), suggesting potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating a potential malfunction or misconfiguration.

Evaluate the effectiveness of active trading strategies and consider adjustments or alternative strategies to improve trading performance.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations and user experience.
